Delete your app account

Last updated: August 11, 2026

You can delete a Cong Le app account and its associated server data from inside the app or by sending us a deletion request.

Delete inside Anniversary Tracker

  1. Open Anniversary Tracker and select Together.
  2. Open account management and select Delete account.
  3. Review the explanation and confirm deletion.

Deleting the app alone does not send an account-deletion request.

Request deletion without the app

Email privacy@cong-le.com with the subject “Anniversary Tracker account deletion.” Send the request from the email address used for the account when possible. If you used Sign in with Apple and hid your email, include the Apple relay address shown for the app.

We may ask for a limited authentication step to prevent someone else from deleting your account. Never send us your password, one-time code, pairing invitation code, birthday, or anniversary details.

What deletion removes

  • Your Congle account, authentication sessions, and provider identifiers held by Congle Accounts.
  • Your registered content-free push-delivery token.
  • The synchronized Together relationship copy, pair membership, queued mutations, and invitations held on our servers.

Relationship data already stored locally on your phone or your invited partner's phone is not remotely erased. Each person can remove that local data in the app or by deleting the app. Operational backups age out under our retention process.

For more information, read the Privacy Policy.
